messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — planning a small py/ts SDK patch publish (v1.14.1) during tomorrow's quiet window (05:00 UTC). Fix: compat with new http client + soft-deprecate sync client.

kyle: SGTM. Question: sticky dist-tag or ephemeral canary flip? Last time `next`->`latest` flip caused pinback churn.

anya: Leaning sticky: publish under `canary-2026-03-22` and do a dist-tag flip after 24h if no issues. We'll add a rollback tag `rollback/1.14.1` and a yank tag if needed.

maria: QA: smoke tests on the patch branch passed locally. Observed flaky Windows wheel signing in CI; re-run in the morning.

sam: If deploy-bot reports non-200 on the registry or index mismatch we hold pinflip. Also prepare revert PR to revert dist-tag and a recovery publish plan.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Publish started: py wheel -> s3://redwood-sdk/py/1.14.1; npm -> registry (canary). CI: 5/7 jobs passed.

maria: CI failing on macOS runner: gpg signing error `gpg: cannot open tty`. Queued re-run with updated runner env.

anya: Hold on any dist-tag changes until CI green. Kyle, please prepare release notes draft inc. migration & deprecation blurb.

kyle: Draft posted: https://internal.redwood/docs/release-notes/1.14.1. Migration snippet added:

```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"))
```

anya: Thanks. If CI green by 08:00 UTC we flip at 09:00 UTC. If not, we yank the publish and tag `yank/1.14.1` and reopen thread.

maria: Re-run succeeded 07:52 UTC. macOS signing issue was missing GPG_TTY in runner env, fixed.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Publish completed: py wheel uploaded, npm package published to `canary-2026-03-22`. CI: 7/7 jobs passed.

anya: Flipping dist-tag at 09:00 UTC. I'll coordinate cross-post in #release-ops. Post-flip we watch errors for 30m; threshold to revert = error spike >0.5% or telemetry regressions on tokenization.

kyle: Acknowledged. I'll monitor telemetry and have revert PR `revert-disttag-1.14.1` ready to merge.

sam: Adding enterprise guidance to CHANGELOG: recommend pinning to `1.14.0` while customers assess deprecation. Example: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.14.0`.

anya: Nice. Thanks all :thumbsup:
